# AI Resume Analyzer & Interview Coach

An AI-powered Resume Analyzer built using Python, Streamlit and Google Gemini.

## Features

- ATS Score Analysis
- Resume Parsing
- Skill Detection
- Missing Skills Identification
- AI Resume Feedback
- Interview Question Generation
- Career Role Recommendation
- Skill Analytics Dashboard

## Tech Stack

- Python
- Streamlit
- Google Gemini API
- Matplotlib
- PDFPlumber

## Run Locally

pip install -r requirements.txt

streamlit run src/app.py
